Honestly I wouldn't recommend buying games for phone, but there's definitely some good games if you're going to actually play them... which I never do, but hey that's just me.

GTA and Minecraft are probably the games you can sink the most time into. The Bard's Tale is a fun game with quite a bit of gameplay if you like top down adventure games. The Five Nights at Freddie's games are pretty great if you like horror. Goat Simulator is another fun sandbox to just fuck around with.

Gameloft is the AAA developer of mobile games if that's what your looking for.

Riptide GP and GP2 are fantastic jetski racing games.

Dead Trigger 1 and 2 are fun zombie survival games, but I think these two are F2P.

Shadowgun is almost Gears of War.

If you really like Fallout then you could wait a couple weeks for it's Android release, but unless it's gotten a lot better since I last played it... I wouldn't recommend it.

Honestly the emulators on Android are great and I'd recommend them over most games. PPSSPP, Drastic DS emulator, and MyBoy GBA emulator are the ones that I'd recommend, but with your specs you shouldn't have issues with anything up to N64 on consoles or PPSSPP for handhelds.

I've heard really good things about Monument Valley, it's a sort of puzzle game, I own it but have yet to play it; there's also Terraria which is good if you've been looking for an open world platformer with building and crafting. If you don't mind slightly slippy controls, there's the classic adventure game Another World, which is pretty fantastic.
